cohort: The study included 220 nulliparous pregnant females in active labor undergoing vaginal delivery, divided into a control group (normal saline) and a paracetamol group (normal saline + 1g paracetamol).
finding: Intravenous paracetamol significantly reduced maternal pain scores during labor and increased patient satisfaction with natural childbirth.
mod_finding: Intravenous paracetamol was found to reduce the need for cesarean birth.
